item.title: Describing recorded sound
item.description: Use precise listening vocabulary when discussing a mix or reviewing a recording. Distinguish tone, space, short-lived changes in sound and levels.

children.definition: Having conspicuously sharp, hiss-like s or similar sounds in speech or singing.
children.example: The first vocal take was so sibilant that every final s drew attention away from the melody.
children.translation_ru: с отчётливо выраженными шипящими или свистящими звуками
children.translation_uz: nutq yoki kuylashda s kabi sirgʻaluvchi tovushlari keskin eshitiladigan

children.definition: Harsh and thin in tone, especially when sharp high frequencies dominate.
children.example: The cymbals sounded brittle in the new mix, with a hard edge and little sense of body.
children.translation_uz: yuqori tovushlari qattiq, jarangi yupqa eshitiladigan

children.definition: Light and open in tone, with a sense of space around fine high-frequency detail.
children.example: The flute had an airy quality that let its smallest changes in breath come through.
children.translation_uz: yengil, ochiq jarangli va mayda yuqori tovushlari seziladigan

children.definition: Hollow and enclosed in tone, with too much emphasis in part of the middle frequency range.
children.example: The guitar sounded boxy, as if the room around it had shrunk to a small wooden cupboard.
children.translation_ru: гулковатый, как в коробке, с избытком средних частот
children.translation_uz: goʻyo quti ichida yangragandek, oʻrta chastotalari ortiqcha boʻlgan

children.definition: Rich and full in tone, with vibrations that continue to be heard after the sound begins.
children.example: The cello’s lowest note was resonant enough to stay audible under the start of the next phrase.
children.translation_uz: toʻliq, boy jarangli va tebranishi uzoqroq eshitiladigan

children.definition: Dull and unclear because some of the higher detail is blocked or lost.
children.example: The spoken introduction sounded muffled, so the quiet consonants were hard to make out.
children.translation_ru: приглушённый, неясный из-за потери высоких частот
children.translation_uz: yuqori tovushlari pasayib, boʻgʻiq va noaniq eshitiladigan

children.definition: Having a large, hollow sound with strong reflections that suggest a very big enclosed space.
children.example: The cavernous recording made a single handclap seem to travel the length of an empty hall.
children.translation_ru: гулкий, с эхом большого пустого помещения
children.translation_uz: katta boʻsh xonadagidek gumburlab, aks sado beradigan

children.definition: Having little audible reverberation or echo around the original sound.
children.example: The drum take was deliberately dry: each hit ended without a sense of room around it.
children.translation_ru: сухой, почти без реверберации или эха
children.translation_uz: aks sadosi deyarli sezilmaydigan quruq jarangli

children.definition: Spread across the listening space so the sound is hard to locate at one distinct point.
children.example: The background choir sounded diffuse, with no single place between the speakers where I could locate it.
children.translation_uz: tinglash makoniga tarqalib, qayerdan kelayotgani aniq bilinmaydigan

children.definition: A brief surge of energy or a sudden change in a sound’s level, often at the start of a note or drum hit.
children.example: The snare transient was still sharp even after we lowered the level of the sound that followed it.
children.translation_ru: краткий всплеск энергии или резкое изменение уровня звука
children.translation_uz: tovush energiyasining qisqa ortishi yoki darajasining keskin oʻzgarishi

children.definition: The gradual decrease in a sound’s level after it reaches its peak.
children.example: The bell’s decay is audible for several seconds after the initial strike.
children.translation_uz: tovushning eng baland nuqtasidan keyin asta-sekin susayishi

children.definition: Having excessive low-frequency energy that makes the bass sound heavy or uncontrolled.
children.example: The bass was boomy in the small room and covered part of the singer’s lower range.
children.translation_uz: past chastotalari ortiqcha, bas tovushi gumburlab chiqadigan

children.definition: The apparent arrangement and spread of performers or sounds across the space suggested by a recording.
children.example: The recording’s soundstage places the piano just left of center and the solitary violin well to the right.
children.translation_ru: звуковая сцена, воспринимаемое расположение источников звука
children.translation_uz: yozuvda tovush manbalari tinglovchiga qanday joylashgandek eshitilishi

children.definition: The margin between the current signal level and the level at which the system begins to overload or clip.
children.example: We left enough headroom above the singer’s loudest rehearsal notes to record a stronger take cleanly.
children.translation_ru: запас уровня сигнала до перегрузки или клиппинга
children.translation_uz: signal darajasi bilan tizim ortiqcha yuklana boshlaydigan daraja orasidagi zaxira
